description: Horaires théoriques et temps réel (GTFS & GTFS-RT) du réseau Palmbus - Cannes Pays de Lérins is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Palmbus. This dataset presents the descriptive elements of the transport offer of the PALMBUS network (lines, stops, timetables,). This data is provided in GTFS format and real-time schedules in GTFS-RT format. On-Demand Transportation (ODT) is included. Coverage: Palmbus. The portal shows the English title as "Theoretical hours and real time (GTFS & GTFS-RT) of the Palmbus network - Cannes Pays de Lérins" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Palmbus. Its keywords include palmbus, le-cannet, cannes, busazur, gtfs-rt, cacpl. The listing shows 4 download or service links in GTFS-RT, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-06-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
